visualCharacteristics.structure: title + product cards (image + brand + title + price + rating + add to cart)

contentPattern.structure: Optional heading row (title), then one row per product: cell 1 = product image, cell 2 = brand + linked title, price, rating, "Add to Cart" link. Alternatively a single config row with recommendation slot id (lws_hp_recommendations_belowimage_0) for runtime population. Optional keyed rows: slot | <id>; pills | <list of filter pill labels> (rendered as a pill bar above the track, first selected).
